definitions.theological-principle: A claim the author grounds in Scripture or doctrine as binding or enduring; record the argument and confessional differences.
definitions.historical-practice: A description of a dated institution, custom, event or implementation; description alone does not establish a universal command.
definitions.practical-advice: A prudential recommendation about how to carry out ministry; distinguish the proposed method from its theological purpose.
